_instructions: The exercise from the post: take three questions your system answers and prepare two transformations for each: a paraphrase and a version with typos. 'facts' are regular expressions for the facts every answer must keep (case-insensitive). Leave 'typos' empty to generate typos automatically. Leave 'answers' empty to use the local assistant, or paste your own system's answers to check them instead.

questions.question: Can I return boots I bought 20 days ago?

questions.question: Can I return sandals I bought 2 months ago?
questions.paraphrase: It has been two months since I bought these sandals. Can I return them?
questions.typos: Can I retrun sandals I bougth 2 months ago?

questions.question: Can I exchange my sneakers for a bigger size? I bought them 10 days ago.
